[nation]Sikirsk[/nation]
[nation]Shahzada[/nation] RP

With the war with Gaesun proving to be more deadly, the pleasure ship HMS Godiva (it is shaped like the IRL Titanic but ofc with modern tech) is quickly sent out from it's docks in Port Augustus and manages to sneak past Gaesunian naval ships, fighters and missiles towards northern Shamat. It is on a mission to New Liberatska City to prepare for the diplomatic team to Sikirsk to return to Empire if the conflict over Empire Island goes sour and the specialties of major foreign officials and teams are required back home. Along with that, it is also a showcase of the Empire's....... [i]pleasurable side[/i]. With it's lavish décor, beautiful and skilled entertainers and finest foods, smells and sounds that Erene has to offer, any guest will certainly never forget their experience on board the ship. 

As a gesture of good will, it is acknowledged between the crew of the ship and the diplomatic team in Sikirsk, that an offer of invite (and friendly competition) on board the ship will be offered to officials of Sikirsk. In preparation for a potential tryst onboard HMS Godiva, the crew have been practising with various crewman and passengers of ocean liners, cruises, fishermen and cargo ships of all nations in international waters who have briefly boarded to experience the best of Balionic culture. Many go away with happy experiences, with some even being forced off the ship as they wish to stay on board with a few cases of people jumping into the ocean as to not go back to their boring lives. 

With one Central Kianzhouian sailor stating; 
"Me love this ship soooo much. Me have fun fun time!"
 
And another lady, hailing from Rossenmarkke, proudly proclaiming as she left the ship;
"My government and news media said Balionic men were wimps. Turns out, [i]they're courageous fighting with tigers[/i]"

The international Erenian Association Press (EAP) also reports on the success of HMS Godiva. With the news of the ship's successes along the way to Sikirsk, Mr X asks the Sikiriskian officials;
"Gentlemen if you wouldn't mind, we have a great ship full of our finest specialities on board coming in to pick us up. We would like to invite you lot on board to have a slight taste of what it would be like for some of your nationals to experience the high life in the Empire."

After a brief pause, Mr X breaks his calm professional exterior and then states "Let's have a friendly competition! Can't give details, but let me bet that our team will win!"
